Subject: SIG kickoff: legal & dataflow clarifying questions and next steps

Hi Eli — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a short list of clarifying questions so we can choose the right questionnaire path (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom):

Summary from call:
- FastMed AI is evaluating Redwood to provide inference for clinical triage and provider notes summarization.
- Primary concern: patient data residency in EU and HIPAA/BAA requirements for US customers.
- You mentioned SOC 2 Type II is in progress; estimated completion Q3.

Clarifying asks (can you confirm by EOD Monday?):
1) SOC 2 status: current phase and expected report date (Type II). Is there a SOC 2 auditor identified?
2) Data residency: which customer data will be stored/processed in EU vs US? Any requirements for EU-only hosting?
3) HIPAA / BAA: do you require Redwood to sign a BAA for initial pilot or only on production rollouts?
4) Questionnaire preference: do you want us to start a SIG prefilling or would you prefer a CAIQ first? If you have an existing vendor security template, please attach.
5) Evidence owners: who at FastMed will own producing network diagrams, infra screenshots, or asset inventories? (name + email)

Attached: a short SIG-prefill template (starter questions) and a stub system diagram we used in similar healthcare pilots. If SIG makes sense we can prefill items we own and leave evidence placeholders for your team.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm answers to 1–5
- We route a prefill and a suggested timeline (targeting a 2-week prefill + evidence collection window)
- Kickoff call with your security/compliance owner (15–30 mins) to align scope

Thanks — I’ll loop Jordan from procurement if you want to discuss commercial timing in the same thread.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales (Vendor Security lead)
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: legal & dataflow clarifying questions and next steps

Thanks Naomi — great recap. Short answers below, happy to expand on a call.

1) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in May 2025. Type II assessment is in progress with Goodmark auditors; ETA for report is 2026-10-15 (tentative).
2) Data residency: For EU pilot customers all PHI and PII must remain in EU regions. Our platform can partition EU customer data into eu-west-1; some logs (non-PII) may be replicated to US for analytics.
3) HIPAA / BAA: We need a BAA for production deployments that process PHI. For pilots we can run under a Data Processing Agreement addendum; procurement prefers to delay full BAA signature until pilot success metrics are met.
4) Questionnaire: SIG would be our preference — our security team likes the standardized mappings. If Redwood can prefill items that are clearly vendor-controlled, that speeds things up.
5) Evidence owners: primary owner is Maya Cohen (Security Manager) m.cohen@fastmed.ai; secondary owner for infra/network is Victor Huang (ops@fastmed.ai).

Attachments: I’m attaching our vendor-assessment-template.docx (procurement prefers this for initial scoping).

Next meeting: we have 30 min slots Mon/Tue next week (9–11am CET). Put me on the calendar and include Maya.

— Eli
CTO, FastMed AI
eli@fastmed.ai
Attach: vendor-assessment-template.docx (attachment stub)

I’m attaching a draft SIG prefill where we’ve filled the vendor-controlled sections (encryption, key management patterns, data handling defaults). Please have Maya confirm the infra owners listed on page 3.
